verdict.rationale: Viam documents a first-party simulation path: the setup wizard can run a machine in a cloud-simulated environment before hardware arrives, and Viam 101 has users build a palletizing cell in simulation with no hardware. The RDK also ships a fake/dummy configuration for running without devices. Nothing in the evidence describes the fidelity of that simulation, so realistic physics and sensor models are unproven. Missing for 10: evidence of realistic physics simulation, simulated sensor models and noise, environment modeling depth, and independent or hands-on corroboration of simulation quality.
